import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545186/attempts/ab0e7680e4554c07981a60f2f64ec0d8/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Grid lines are the single color that forms a complete interior row/column.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(1, h - 1) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(1, w - 1) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # A separator color occurs as a complete line; select the most frequent such line color.
    line_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in row_lines] + [grid[0][c] for c in col_lines]
    sep = max(set(line_colors), key=line_colors.count)
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    row_cells = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_cells = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    # The least common non-separator color is the panel background.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best = None
    best_count = 0
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_cells):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_cells):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            if count > best_count:
                best, best_count = (ri, ci), count
    sr0, sr1 = row_cells[best[0]]
    sc0, sc1 = col_cells[best[1]]
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(sc0, sc1)] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_cells):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_cells):
            if (ri, ci) == best:
                continue
            for dr, r in enumerate(range(r0, r1)):
                for dc, c in enumerate(range(c0, c1)):
                    out[r][c] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
